abstract: This issue of the SMPTE Motion Imaging Journal takes a broad look at current implementations and future considerations for the media content creation, production, and distribution components that surround and support the moving image industries. The papers in this issue present a common theme—one that deals with the term “infrastructure” in reference to the various terminologies, components, and practices that make up the capture, manipulation, distribution, and reproduction of moving (television) images.

authors.bio: Karl Paulsen is a SMPTE fellow and the chief technology officer at Diversified Systems. Paulsen is a member of SMPTE's standards development community and a regular industry contributor in his ongoing monthly column on media servers and storage technologies in the TV Technology magazine. He is the author of two books on the subject of video servers and storage systems; the latest is Moving Media Storage Technologies: Applications and Workflows for Video and Media Server Platforms (Focal Press, 2011).
